title: Nothing tests hq/anim.py
ask:
anim.py now carries loop discovery, staleness detection, script re-running with clamped overrides, and an unattended run launcher that spends money. It was verified by hand at every step — including with the CLI stubbed — but none of that is repeatable, and hq/ has no Python test harness at all while the Godot suites have two.

The pieces worth pinning are the ones where being wrong is expensive or silent: overrides clamped to a parameter's declared range, a slug that fails the name pattern being refused, the ignored-overrides comparison that stops the page reporting a redraw that did not happen, staleness computed against the right mtime, and a run that fails filing no work item. A stub for subprocess.run is enough for the last of those; it is how the launcher was checked before it ever ran.
first_action: Add hq/test_anim.py with a plain runner, covering clamping, slug refusal, ignored-overrides detection, staleness, and the run launcher's two failure paths
source_message: Filed 2026-09-09 when Daniel asked whether any shortcuts taken while building the Animation Lab should be refactored or hardened. The module extraction and index caching were done in d417023; these two were not.
result: Animation Lab has a plain hq/test_anim.py runner on main. It checks both clamp bounds, invalid slug refusal, ignored overrides, staleness against params.json mtime even when the sprite sheet is newer, and failed, unnamed, and timed-out unattended runs filing no review item. The runner passed 13 tests locally and in the GitHub Actions writing job. GitHub Actions run 35981516789 passed all three jobs: gateway, tests, and writing.
